source: User-approved generated Celine reference images supplied in ChatGPT on 2026-08-26
hierarchy_rule: When references disagree: face_master wins for face/eyes/hair identity; body_front_master wins for frontal proportions/outfit; the two side profiles win for profile depth/silhouette; body_back_master wins for back/hair/hip/glute rear silhouette; character sheets are secondary only for expressions, styling intent and technical guidance.
geometry_input_policy: For the v75 character rebuild, the five PRIMARY single-view masters are the authoritative geometry/identity inputs. The two character-sheet composites are SECONDARY only and must never override a primary master or block v75 geometry work if unavailable.

identity_constraints.hair: long, blonde, softly wavy, fuller/more voluminous than current Celine
identity_constraints.face: match face_master as the primary identity reference; do not preserve old-face identity if it conflicts
identity_constraints.body: slim feminine overall, defined waist, fuller hips/glute silhouette than current Celine, natural rather than exaggerated; geometry/weights preferred over unsafe bone scaling
identity_constraints.outfit: beige off-shoulder long-sleeve ribbed top, fitted black jeans, white sneakers, small necklace
identity_constraints.overall: photorealistic, warm, friendly, feminine, natural; avoid plastic/cartoon drift

face_master.png.role: PRIMARY: face identity, green eye appearance, skin, lips, nose, brows, hair color/texture

body_front_master.png.role: PRIMARY: frontal body proportions, outfit, stance/silhouette

body_side_facing_right.png.role: PRIMARY: one side-profile depth/silhouette; especially chest/waist/hip/glute/back relationship

body_back_master.png.role: PRIMARY: back silhouette, rear hair, shoulders, hips/glute/legs and jeans fit

character_sheet_technical.png.role: SECONDARY: expression/rig/technical intent only; never override a primary master view

character_sheet_expression_style.png.role: SECONDARY: mood, expression, styling and desired natural presence only; never override a primary master view

reference_pack.note: Full seven-image archive remains the canonical preservation pack. For v75 geometry, prefer the verified individual PRIMARY files below if archive materialization is unavailable.

retrieval_fallback.instruction: Attempt the five individual PRIMARY Library files directly before retrying the full ZIP. Verify each byte length and SHA-256 against this manifest. Do not wait for or use the two secondary character-sheet composites as geometry authority. If all five PRIMARY hashes match, the v75 visual rebuild is unblocked and may proceed.
retrieval_fallback.materialization_probe: All five individual PRIMARY files were successfully materialized together after the earlier ZIP HTTP 502 failure.
